measureRecords.whatItDoes: Increase Town Council terms to four years, with staggered terms starting after the November 2028 general election.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve staggered four-year council terms starting after the November 2028 election.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed change to council terms.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Add posting on the town website to the charter’s public-hearing notice provisions in sections C-2.08(6) and C-2.13(d).
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve adding town-website posting to those notice provisions.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed change to public-hearing notices.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Remove the charter requirement to enact an ordinance when conveying or leasing town real estate.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep the charter’s ordinance requirement for those town-property transactions.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Make adopted ordinances take effect upon adoption instead of after 30 days, unless the ordinance states otherwise.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve immediate effect upon adoption, unless otherwise stated.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed change to when ordinances take effect.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Add a bachelor’s degree in criminal justice or a related field to the police chief’s qualifications.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve that degree requirement for the police chief.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed addition to the police chief’s qualifications.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Add parks and oversight of the Smithfield Water Department’s daily operations to the Public Works Department’s responsibilities. Rename the Parks and Recreation Department the Recreation Department.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve both the public-works responsibility changes and the department name change.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed set of department changes.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Revise the town solicitor’s charter role for consistency with state law and expressly state the required qualifications.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve revising the solicitor’s role and qualifications in the charter.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed charter revision for the town solicitor.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Rename the charter section for the Director of Human Services as the Human Services Department and add its organization, duties and required qualifications.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the new department section and its organization, duties and qualifications.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed Human Services charter change.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Remove issuing plumbing and drainage permits from the building official’s charter duties.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve removing those permit duties from the building official’s charter responsibilities.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed change to the building official’s duties.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Require publication of notices when town boards and commissions have vacancies.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve requiring public notices of those vacancies.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Add an Engineering Department section to the charter describing its organization, duties and the town engineer’s required qualifications.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve adding that Engineering Department section.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed addition to the charter.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow the Town Council to establish a free municipal library system with locations in Esmond and Greenville. A board of trustees appointed by the council would oversee it.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve giving the council that authority, with the stated locations and trustee oversight.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed authority to establish the library system.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Add a Planning and Economic Development Department to the charter, describing its organization, duties and the planning director’s required qualifications.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve adding that department section to the charter.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Raise the charter’s capital-item threshold from amounts greater than $10,000 to amounts greater than $30,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve raising that threshold to more than $30,000.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep the threshold at more than $10,000.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Replace the current five-year audit system with annual departmental reports tracking at least five clear performance measures and trends over time. Selected departments would also receive an independent review each year to check accuracy and recommend improvements. The Budget and Financial Review Board would choose the independent firm.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve replacing the five-year system with those annual reports and independent reviews.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject replacing the current five-year audit system with this proposal.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Require the Town Council and School Committee to hold four joint workshop meetings each year.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve requiring four joint workshops per year.
